target.title: fix(models): add provider request rate limits
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves
Provider model requests can currently burst into an upstream API without a local pacing/backlog guard. This adds an opt-in provider/model/baseUrl request limiter for the model-provider HTTP dispatch path only: rolling requests-per-minute, minimum inter-dispatch spacing, and bounded local queue rejection.

This is a focused provider-dispatch slice of the broader rate-limit tracker; tool/channel calls, budgets, metrics, backoff, and CLI/status UX remain out of scope here.

Refs #13615.

## Summary
- add `models.providers.*.request.rateLimit` schema/types/help for provider-scoped request pacing
- route rate-limited provider models through the managed OpenClaw transport seam
- add local per provider/model/baseUrl request buckets with rolling RPM, minimum interval, and bounded queue rejection
- fix review blockers: typed transport mock, abort waits reject with `Error`, and `maxQueueSize: 0` allows immediate dispatch while rejecting requests that would queue

## Evidence

Real local transport proof using a temporary HTTP server and `buildGuardedModelFetch` with provider request metadata:

```text
$ node --import tsx /tmp/openclaw-rate-limit-proof.ts
pacing: hits=2 gapMs=216 result=PASS
rejection: hits=1 status=429 code=provider_rate_limit_queue_full result=PASS
```

Focused checks run after the review fixes:

```text
$ cd src/agents && node ../../scripts/run-vitest.mjs run --config ../../test/vitest/vitest.agents.config.ts provider-transport-fetch.test.ts --reporter verbose
Test Files  1 passed (1)
Tests  83 passed (83)

$ node scripts/run-tsgo.mjs -p test/tsconfig/tsconfig.core.test.agents.json --noEmit --pretty false --singleThreaded --checkers 1
# passed

$ ./node_modules/.bin/oxlint --tsconfig config/tsconfig/oxlint.core.json src/agents/provider-transport-fetch.ts src/agents/provider-transport-fetch.test.ts
Found 0 warnings and 0 errors.

$ ./node_modules/.bin/oxfmt --check --threads=1 src/agents/provider-transport-fetch.ts src/agents/provider-transport-fetch.test.ts
All matched files use the correct format.

$ pnpm config:docs:check && git diff --check
OK docs/.generated/config-baseline.sha256
```

Full local `pnpm check:test-types` was attempted, but the repo-wide core test type pass exceeded this constrained host's runtime; the focused agents test tsconfig above passed. Full `pnpm lint --threads=8` reached the unrelated plugin-sdk package boundary dts prerequisite timeout after the touched files passed focused oxlint/format.
